subject.title: Páginas de autor publican texto de Wikipedia (CC BY-SA) e imágenes de Commons sin atribución

question: Should Hamelyn remediate author pages by avoiding Wikipedia/Commons licensed content, or by storing and displaying full attribution for it?
rationale: Both paths are valid but they have different legal, content, schema, UI, and backfill consequences that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Avoid licensed content
options.body: Generate author descriptions from CC0 facts only and allow only public-domain/CC0 images or placeholders, reducing ongoing attribution burden.

options.title: Add attribution support
options.body: Keep Wikipedia/Commons content only after adding source, author, license, license URL, and changed-state metadata through ingestion, storage, storefront, and JSON-LD.

recommendation.title: Avoid licensed content
recommendation.body: Generate author descriptions from CC0 facts only and allow only public-domain/CC0 images or placeholders, reducing ongoing attribution burden.

likelyOwner.reason: JavierHamelyn already performed the triage validation and framed the next step as containment followed by a definitive A/B implementation decision.
